  "citations": [ { "chunk_id": "C2", "quote": "Subject to payment of the Annual Minimum Commitment (“AMC” - defined herein), PARTY_1 hereby grants to Reseller an exclusive, non-transferable and non-assignable right to market, sell, and sub-license those PARTY_1 products listed in Schedule 2 (the “Products”) within the territory listed in Schedule 3 (the “Territory”) to Canadian headquartered companies, and governmental and broader public sector entities located in Canada." } ] }
